Welcome to Antelope Valley College! Our vision is to offer the community quality education that will transform your lives. The classified professionals, faculty, and administrators at AVC are here to serve you and make your time here productive and memorable. AVC offers inspiring programs and courses in state-of-the-art facilities that are located in Lancaster, Palmdale, and at Fox Field. From non-credit offerings to certificates, to associate degrees, to a bachelor's degree, we are proud of the comprehensive opportunities that await you. I hope you make AVC your home, that you immediately feel welcome on this campus, and that all of your experiences are inclusive, positive, and successful. You are joining a diverse student body who is supported by a diverse group of faculty, classified professionals, and administrators whose goal is to ensure your success.

As president, it is my privilege to ensure that students come first. I am committed to the vision and mission of the college, and most important to student access and success. During pandemic times, AVC responded to student needs with computer loans, hotspots, and food distribution. We will continue to do all we can to meet existing and emerging needs so that barriers to learning are removed and the path to success is clear and direct.
It is my privilege to serve you here at Antelope Valley College, where Students Come First!

excerpts.line: Message from the President - En Español
window: It is my privilege to serve you here at Antelope Valley College, where Students Come First!
Message from the President - En Español

¡Bienvenidos al Colegio Antelope Valley! Nuestra visión es ofrecer a la comunidad una educación de calidad que transformará sus vidas. Los profesionales clasificados, la facultad y los administradores del AVC están aquí para servirles y hacer que su tiempo aquí sea productivo y memorable. AVC ofrece programas y cursos inspiradores en instalaciones de vanguardia ubicadas en Lancaster, Palmdale y Fox Field. Desde ofertas sin créditos hasta certificados, títulos de asociado y títulos de licenciatura, estamos orgullosos de las oportunidades integrales que les esperan.

Espero que hagan de AVC su hogar, que inmediatamente se sientan bienvenidos en este campus y que todas sus experiencias sean inclusivas, positivas y exitosas. Ustedes se están uniendo a un cuerpo estudiantil diverso que es apoyado por un grupo diverso de profesores, profesionales clasificados y administradores cuyo objetivo es garantizar su éxito.

Como presidente, tengo el privilegio de garantizar que los estudiantes sean lo primero. Estoy comprometido con la visión y la misión del colegio y, lo que es más importante, con el acceso y el éxito de los estudiantes. Durante tiempos de la pandemia, AVC respondió a las necesidades de los estudiantes con préstamos de computadoras, puntos de acceso y distribución de alimentos. Continuaremos haciendo todo lo que podamos para satisfacer las necesidades existentes y emergentes para que se eliminen las barreras para el aprendizaje y que el camino hacia el éxito sea claro y directo.

Articulation is the process of determining whether a course or group of courses offered at Antelope Valley College (AVC) is equivalent or comparable to a corresponding course or group of courses at another institution.

An articulation agreement is, most commonly, an agreement between Antelope Valley College and a college or university which specifies which Antelope Valley College courses may be transferred to meet general education, major or elective requirements. Antelope Valley College has a number of articulation agreements with California State University (CSU), University of California (UC) and private institutions in California as well as out of state. These agreements may be found in the Counseling Office and the Transfer Center. These agreements will facilitate the successful transfer of Antelope Valley College students to baccalaureate level colleges and universities.

If AVC does not have an Articulation Agreement with my transfer university, how may I determine the correct classes to take at AVC?

If you wish to transfer to a university with whom AVC does not have an agreement, you may obtain preliminary information about that university’s requirements from their catalog and/or their web page. The AVC Transfer Center can assist you in locating this information. Then make an appointment with a counselor to obtain advisement about how to best meet these requirements at AVC.
